outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed in frame 0 (image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward in frames 91–115 (image and left_ego_image). By frames 115–123, the door is lowered and the oven interior is exposed; it remains open after the gripper withdraws through frame 148. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
